releaseNotes:
v6.8.0 — Security, Architecture & Performance Release

• Code Hardening: Full R8 minification, resource shrinking, and comprehensive ProGuard rules enabled for smaller and faster APKs.
• Security & Privacy: Enforced strict HTTPS network security configuration, playback notification gating in onboarding, dedicated Permissions Manager in Settings, and voice search permission rationales.
• YouTube Engine: Consolidated NewPipe Extractor v0.26.5 for enhanced audio stream extraction.
• Modern Foundation: Updated Compose BOM to 2025.02.00 for improved UI smoothness and stability.
• Modular Architecture: Optimized onboarding and AI components into modular, high-performance layers.
